info.title: FPR API
info.description: Generated from the route contracts in `@fpr/contracts` by `pnpm contracts:openapi`. `x-roles` lists the roles a route accepts. `x-anonymize` marks a field the anonymizer changes for an anonymous viewer: `personal` is replaced, `euro` is removed and the percentage beside it stays, and `quantity` is replaced with its weight in the portfolio.
